units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:1">Kidd. I, 1</cite> and she becomes her own master <he>בגט ובמיתת הב׳</he> through a letter of divorce or on the husband’s death; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:6:2">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ב׳ ראש גוייה הוה וכ׳</he> the Baal was the phallus and had the shape of a bean [read <he>וכאפון</he>].
Is. LV, 10). בֵּית בַּ׳ a field sufficiently watered by rain and requiring no artificial irrigation.
<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:1">Tosef. M. Kat. I, 1</cite> <he>שדה</he> (<he>בית</he>) <he>הב׳</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 2:7">Tosef. Succ. II, 7</cite> <he>ערבה של ב׳</he> (sub. <he>בית</he>) a willow in a naturally watered field.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:4">Shebi. II, 4</cite> <he>בשל ב׳</he> (= <he>בשדה של ב׳</he>), opp. <he>של שוקי</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:25">Num. R. s. 16</cite> the Egyptian gods <he>של שקר הם</he> (read <cite ref="U01849"><he>שקי</he></cite>) are gods of artificial drainage, but those of Canaan <he>של ב׳ הם</he> are gods of rain; (Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 13, through misunderstanding, <he>שקר … בעליכח</he>.

senses.gloss: (mostly in compounds) owner of, master of, possessed of, given to &c.; e.g. ב׳ אבידה owner of a lost object; ב׳ אגדה master of Agadah, lecturer; ב׳ דין opponent in court; v. infra.
units: Pes. 86ᵇ ב׳ השם אני I am so named.—Pl. בְּעָלִים, בְּעָלִין owners; mostly as sing. owner.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:1">B. Mets. VIII, 1</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:2:3">Y. Dem. III, 23ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>לבלעין</he>, read <he>לבעלין</he>.]
Ib. בעלי מ׳ those entertaining considerations (of fear), hesitating to do justice.—ב׳ שיבה gray-haired.
Succ. 53ᵃ; a. fr.—ב׳ תשובות a man of many objections or excuses.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:2">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> beg.—[For other compounds, not self-evident, see the respective determinants.]
